name: @epoch/client-runtime
description: Epoch Shared Client Runtime (W046, ACR-005) — the client-facing contract spine shared by all three product clients (web/desktop/mobile): the typed Application Gateway operation vocabulary + request/response envelopes, the recoverable client error taxonomy (transient / auth-session-expired / conflict / validation / authority-rejected / unrecoverable) with typed discriminators that map to UI recovery states (offline queue vs. re-auth vs. hard failure), correlation ids propagated through gateway -> kernel calls, the typed IdempotentReplay (operation key + request fingerprint + recorded outcome — replays never double-apply), the offline admission queue holding PENDING PROJECTIONS of user intent only (the five named admission negatives: no local approval authority, no local semantic-truth mutation, no local identity minting, no local digest/verification forgery, replay must go through the Action Gateway with idempotency keys or be rejected), the read-only projection cache, and the deterministic emission of contracts/application-gateway (manifest + per-contract digests + parity). Deterministic: zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied. NO client transport implementation, NO UI, NO semantic authority.
